blocks.title: Published releases.
blocks.lead: Everything here is a published GitHub release, read from GitHub when the site was built. These are development builds: expect rough edges.

blocks.title: Etesian for the F(x)tec Pro1-X
blocks.text: The full ROM as an OTA package for LineageOS recovery, with its SHA-256 checksum. A development build, signed by the project’s CI.
blocks.note: Only the F(x)tec Pro1-X has a build. Other phones that run LineageOS 24 need their own build; none exists yet.
blocks.button: How to install on the Pro1-X
blocks.intro: Etesian installs from LineageOS recovery with adb sideload. You need an unlocked bootloader, LineageOS recovery for the Pro1-X (the LineageOS wiki’s pro1x install guide covers both) and adb on a computer.
steps: Download `etesian-{{rom.version}}-pro1x.zip` and its `.sha256` file, then check it: `sha256sum -c etesian-{{rom.version}}-pro1x.zip.sha256`.
Back up anything you need. Then reboot into recovery: `adb reboot recovery`.

Coming from stock or another ROM, official LineageOS included: choose Factory reset → Format data / factory reset. Etesian is signed with its own keys. Updating an earlier Etesian build: skip this step.
Choose Apply update → Apply from ADB, then on the computer run `adb sideload etesian-{{rom.version}}-pro1x.zip`.
If recovery says the signature can’t be verified, choose Yes to continue: the package is signed with Etesian’s keys, not LineageOS’s.
When it finishes, choose Reboot system now.

blocks.title: Glance
blocks.text: A standalone APK for any Android phone. Without the ROM’s platform key it can’t show app shortcuts or join the launcher (the News view, search in Applications); on Etesian, Glance comes built into the ROM.

blocks.title: Etesian in a container
blocks.text: Etesian on LineageOS 24 as a Docker image that runs like Redroid: one container, no virtual machine. Published as ghcr.io/etesian-design/redroid, signed with the release keys and boot-tested before each release.
blocks.note: A privileged container shares the host’s kernel. Run it on a machine you can afford to lose, or in a virtual machine.
blocks.intro: On a Linux host with Docker:
steps: Load the kernel modules: `sudo modprobe binder_linux devices=binder,hwbinder,vndbinder` and `sudo modprobe af_key`.

`docker run -d --privileged -v etesian-data:/data -p 127.0.0.1:5555:5555 ghcr.io/etesian-design/redroid:latest androidboot.redroid_width=1080 androidboot.redroid_height=1920 androidboot.redroid_dpi=420 androidboot.use_memfd=1`
Connect with `adb connect 127.0.0.1:5555`, and see the screen with scrcpy (`scrcpy -s 127.0.0.1:5555`).
Your data stays in the `etesian-data` volume; remove the container and the volume to start again.

blocks.title: Etesian for KDE Plasma
blocks.text: No packages yet. Install it from the repository with its install script; see the Plasma page.

blocks.title: Cloud Companion
blocks.text: A Phorepoc project in the Etesian look. Experimental. Releases carry a Raspberry Pi image, phehost binaries for Linux (amd64, arm64), an install script and checksums.

paragraphs: Not published: builds for any other phone, Plasma packages, and the work built since the latest ROM release (see Progress). Nokia images, sounds and fonts are never published.
